title: 18-Year-Old Girl Arrested After Fight Then Gets Busted for Fake ID
description:
On September 18, 2021, officers were patrolling the area when they observed a crowd gathering around a physical altercation in La Crosse, WI. When the aggressor was confronted, she was arrested and uncooperative with the officers and gave jailers a difficult time. It was later discovered she also had possession of a fake ID.
